source_title: Inventus Power Launches the LV-24V50, a Compact 24V Lithium-ion Battery for Next-Generation Robotics and Material Handling - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
The newest PROformance Li-ion Series battery delivers 1.2 kWh in a footprint sized for AMR and AGV chassis.
WOODRIDGE, Ill. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Inventus Power (inventuspower.com), a global leader in advanced battery and power systems, today announced the launch of its LV-24V50, the newest addition to its PROformance Li-ion Series. Part of the PROTRXionÂ® family, the LV-24V50 is a 24V lithium-iron phosphate (LiFePOâ) battery pack built for the growing power demands of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automated guided vehicles (AGVs), and other material handling equipment. Samples are available now for OEM evaluation.
Compact, High-Power Design for AMRs and AGVs
Robotic and automated material handling platforms need more power density, faster charging, and smarter power management. The LV-24V50 delivers 1.2 kWh of rated energy and close to 5 kW of peak power in a compact package engineered for space-constrained robot and AGV chassis, so OEMs can integrate quickly and scale fleets without redesign.
Its 48Ah capacity is sized for full-shift runtime on small platforms without adding unnecessary cost, weight, or volume, which matters for OEMs running high-volume production programs.
The LV-24V50 can fully charge in approximately one hour, keeping fleets in service longer and reducing time spent on the charger in continuous warehouse, manufacturing, and logistics operations.
Intelligent Power Management with a Proprietary BMS
At the core of the LV-24V50 is Inventus Power's proprietary battery management system (BMS). CANopen communication, soft-start pre-charge control, and active cell balancing work together to optimize performance, safety, and battery life, while giving OEM engineers visibility into state of charge, system health, and fault conditions.
Integrated LED status indicators show battery health at a glance, so technicians and operators can check status without additional diagnostic tools, simplifying service and reducing fleet downtime.
Lower Total Cost of Ownership Than Lead-Acid
Battery-powered industrial equipment needs longer runtime, a smaller footprint, and lower total cost of ownership without sacrificing safety or serviceability. The LV-24V50 is designed to deliver all three.
As a replacement for legacy sealed lead-acid (SLA) batteries, the LV-24V50 offers up to three times the cycle life and 40% less weight, helping OEM customers increase uptime and reduce fleet operating costs.
" Robotics and material handling OEMs have been asking for a smarter, more compact 24V lithium battery, one that charges fast and reports its own health. The LV-24V50 delivers exactly that. Designed for space-conscious AGV and AMR integration, it gives engineers the data they need from day one. We expect it to become a reference platform for 24V lithium in next-generation autonomous systems ," â Torin Schneider, Senior Product Manager, Inventus Power
The LV-24V50 is available now for sampling and OEM evaluation. Inventus Power's application engineering team provides full design-in support, including system integration guidance and charger compatibility.
